summary: Manwe: an alpha perception research workbench for vision, audio, multi-camera geometry and multi-target tracking, with a NumPy-only Python core, optional model pillars, a Rust inference CLI on a schema-2 model contract, and an Apple Metal benchmark crate. AGENTS.md is the operating contract; this index restates its facts for tools.

entry_documents.role: architecture, ownership, datasets and native runtime
training, inference, export, recovery and numerical examples
artifact admission, tensors, preprocessing, taxonomy and fidelity
consumer adapters, frames, clocks, identity and PID extraction boundary

delivery.merge: Commit and push the exact gated milestone to main; main has no branch protection, so the applicable complete gate is the check before a push.
delivery.signing: required: sign every commit; the Git configuration signs with the owner's SSH key
delivery.attribution: no AI attribution or co-author trailers

gates.when: python/ or a Python dependency changes
metal-yolo-tests/ changes; needs macOS with Metal
agent-index.json or a path it names changes

generated.regenerate: uv lock in python/, only after an installed compatibility review and a reviewed lock diff
cargo update, only after an installed compatibility review and a reviewed lock diff
cargo update in metal-yolo-tests/, only after an installed compatibility review and a reviewed lock diff

frozen.reason: historical figures kept as dated records; do not rewrite

ecosystem.relation: intended consumer of perception models; no implemented adapter
possible consumer of tracking output; no implemented adapter
no implemented adapter; tracking frames are autocorrelated and are not valid PID samples by themselves
